# Copilot Instructions

- Keep this workspace focused on the AI Study Assistant with RAG + Voice.
- Prefer minimal, production-minded scaffolding over toy examples.
- Use FastAPI for the backend and React for the frontend.
- Preserve the document-grounded RAG behavior: answers must rely only on retrieved document context.
- Keep user-facing text concise and clear.
- Update this file as the project evolves.
